'''''Venenit shadaaga''''', also known as '''Hutt venom''', was a chemical that was a primary ingredient in many [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenal]] stimulants. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]],<ref name="Holonet" /> the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Bardian Aelto]]<ref name="Discovering">{{TORcite|type=codex|Discovering Quesh Venom}}</ref> discovered an almost identical chemical on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] which was later named ''[[venenit queshaaga]]''.<ref name="Codex Venom">{{TORcite|type=codex|Quesh Venom}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''Venenit shadaaga'' was first mentioned in Quesh's entry on [[the Holonet]] section of the official site for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Holonet" /> It was later mentioned in several Codex entries in the game,<ref name="Discovering" /><ref name="Codex Venom" /> as well as the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', which reprinted the Holonet summary on Quesh; however, the ''Explorer's Guide'' mistakenly referred to it as ''queshaaga''.<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
